patch.value: Exclude nested pm-vcs control directories from staging and materialization

Separate follow-up to the existing control-directory fence in pm-vcs-aujy. The working-tree walker excludes .pmvcs only at the repository root, while ALWAYS_IGNORED omits .pmvcs. A scratch parent repository with a nested agent-a repository stages agent-a/.pmvcs/credentials.json on unrestricted add; this can publish clone credentials and other private control state. Fix the general staging, explicit-add, status and materialization fence; cover nested control directories and malicious stored trees. This is outside the two requested PR #91 defects.

Initialize a scratch parent Repository and agent-a child Repository; add an authenticated origin to the child RemoteStore; call parent.stage([]); parent.readIndex() contains agent-a/.pmvcs/credentials.json.
Own control directories remain private at every nesting depth and cannot be materialized from stored trees.
The synthetic reproduction at e131473 returned nestedControlTracked=true.

Plan: a non-negatable case-insensitive control-name fence at every depth, filesystem alias protection, legacy index sanitation, and stored-tree defenses across materialize, restore and sparse views. Tests will preserve ordinary source and PM records and prove the regression by reverting behavior only.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Review 4211826119 is valid: preflight checks leave path-based mkdir/write/chmod/unlink and pruning exposed to ancestor replacement. Plan: capture no-follow directory descriptors and device/inode identities before mutation; perform child operations through pinned descriptor paths, revalidate ancestry around each operation, use exclusive no-follow file creation and descriptor writes/chmod, and use non-recursive unlink/rmdir. Threat: a concurrent local writer swaps a checked directory or leaf for an outside/control-state symlink. Deterministic filesystem hooks will cover both materialize and restore, including the final check/use gap; behavioral function reverts must make the tests fail. Unsupported descriptor-path backends will refuse safely.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Independent read-only Sol CLI investigation confirmed the original write/chmod, unlink and recursive-pruning races and checked direct callers. Implemented shared WorktreeMutation descriptor-pinned topology with exclusive no-follow leaf creation, fd write/chmod, non-recursive deletion, ancestor identity checks and fail-closed procfs capability checks. Focused existing tests passed; 18 deterministic race/alias/backend tests passed, including both APIs at mkdir/open/unlink into outside and nested control state, pruning, root/ordinary inode replacement and hardlink isolation. The guarantee concerns redirection through replaced pathnames; descriptors retain the originally opened objects, as with openat, rather than enforcing a sandbox against an actor directly relocating those objects.
